fato_historico: 1456: Ulrich II, Count of Celje, last ruler of the County of Cilli, is assassinated in Belgrade.
energia_do_dia: Today, the cosmic atmosphere encourages you to release old burdens and cycles of conflict, much like the changing tides of history. It is a good time to embrace diplomacy in your relationships. Perhaps you may find that letting go of past tensions creates a beautiful space for new partnerships and personal growth to flourish in your life.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the wisdom to choose peace over lingering discord.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual reflection, inner wisdom, and the search for deeper truth.
conselho: Consider listening more than speaking today to foster deeper connections with those around you.
